json.title: Internal error

plain_lines: Capture authority error: capture authority transition is already in progress
An unexpected internal error occurred. This is likely a bug in ft.
• Capture authority rejected an unsafe pane or source transition.
• Retry discovery only after the exact predecessor source has drained; do not relabel queued capture events.
Run `ft why FT-9001` for more details.
